column1: # Rows db.ak.* (line RG, series D, D1a; remaining-gaps-20261112/D): alias-file keys on tests/db_search/aliaskeys (alias files over taxfilter/tfp, taxfilter/tfn and multidb/p4a): NSEQ and LENGTH as NCBI's walks, STATS_NSEQ, STATS_TOTLEN, MIN_SEQ_LENGTH, FIRST_OID and LAST_OID ranges, VDBLIST, a volume reached twice; the .err rows are NCBI's CStringException texts (exit 255, the release build's path).

# Rows db.ak.*.e0* and db.ak.*.ord.* (line RG, series D, D1a-2; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/SURVEY_D1a2_C.md D, E): alias files over volumes of no OID (tests/seqdb/db/empty, aliaskeys/en) with NSEQ, LENGTH, STATS_NSEQ and STATS_TOTLEN (NCBI reads OID 0 only when the statistics' total is not positive), and the order of the errors of the alias files' values, the lists, the headers (aliaskeys/dh: multidb/p4a with a damaged header file) and the accession tables (multidb/na and nnp); the CStringException texts carry the release build's path.

# Rows db.ak.bp.*x6*, db.ak.bp.rej.nseq0.oldfsc.blocks*, *.b1*, db.ak.bp.*l55* (line RG series D, item bp-SF1, 2026-11-27): BLASTP's refusals of a call's setup (a statistics count of 0 without the Gumbel block, a search space that overflows Int8) come after the reports of the query batches before the batch that meets them, as NCBI's batch loop prints them (aliaskeys/p_l55: LENGTH 2^55 over taxfilter/tfp; aliaskeys/q_hba.faa: taxfilter/q.faa's letters as hba, q_hba_long.faa: hba and long, hba 35 times; fasta/rps/x6only.faa: x6q.faa's six X-only queries)

D1a: STATS_TOTLEN alone

D1a: MIN_SEQ_LENGTH 1000 (the shortest length of the preliminary cutoff)
D1a: MAX_SEQ_LENGTH is never read, even when it is not a number
D1a: VDBLIST: CSeqDB does not read it

D1a: a range in XML: Statistics_db-num and db-len are the volume's
D1a: nested ranges are ANDed: OIDs 4-9
D1a: two ranges of one volume from two alias files are ORed; the counts sum both
D1a: a volume named by an alias file and by DBLIST directly: read once, counted twice
D1a: a volume twice in one DBLIST is one volume
D1a: FIRST_OID 0 is FIRST_OID 1
D1a: LAST_OID alone

D1a: a range beyond the database: no OID
D1a: a range and -taxids are ANDed; the scan counts the OIDs of both, the report the walk
D1a: a range and -negative_taxids
D1a: with -taxids: NSEQ/LENGTH printed, STATS_NSEQ and the scanned length in the statistics
D1a: a range and -seqidlist
